# 万能帮帮（BangBang）

> 万能帮帮是值得信赖的华人互助与任务撮合平台。无论线上服务还是线下跑腿，让有需要的人快速发布及时任务、找到合适的帮手，也让有技能、有时间的人轻松接活赚钱。
>
> BangBang is a trusted platform where the Chinese community helps each other and gets tasks done. From online services to offline errands, people who need help can quickly post a task and find the right helper, and people with skills and spare time can easily take on jobs and earn.

BangBang Life Pty Ltd · support@bangbanglife.com.au
